description: Create a standalone image from a description, or EDIT an uploaded image by passing imageUrl and describing the changes — a picture on its own, with NO post, caption or schedule attached. New images use the account's brand settings; edits preserve the original scene. For a named person (e.g. Tina), first call use_character_reference and pass its referenceImageUrls so the actual person appears in the edit. Use this when the user asks for an image, a picture, a thumbnail or a graphic rather than a post. Takes about a minute; returns a batchId to check with get_image_status. To put an image ON a post instead, use change_image or create_post_from_image.

aspectRatio.description: Shape. Defaults to 4:5, or 16:9 for a thumbnail

cameraStyle.description: The look of the photography. Defaults to the account's own setting

count.description: How many variants, 1-3. Defaults to 1 — each extra one is a separate generation

description.description: What the image should show, in plain language

imageType.description: What the image is for. Defaults to the account's own setting; use 'thumbnail' for a video or article thumbnail

imageUrl.description: Original image to edit; omit for a new image

referenceImageUrls.description: Character identity references from use_character_reference or user-provided reference photos

name: create_image
title: Create Image
